newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico needs credit for vibrant GDP growth - group.
newsitem.headline: Mexico needs credit for vibrant GDP growth - group.

text.p: A leading Mexican business group on Tuesday said new credit was vital for Mexico to achieve its goal of 4.5 percent economic growth in 1997.

"This year we have the enormous responsibility of substantially improving credit, because if not how are we going to generate 4.5 percent GDP (growth)?", said Carlos Gutierrez, head of the National Manufacturing Industry Chamber.
He said many companies, still struggling to recover from the 1994-1995 peso crisis, needed liquidity to get projects off the ground.
He said the chamber, known as Canacintra, was advising its members on how to apply for credit and on providing loan guarantees to speed up the flow of funds.
